And one more quick note, for b4xxxx, there are a lot more then just 5 possibilities, the way hex colours work, is by using hex(a base 16 counting system) to represent the RBG values from 0 to 255 (our base 10 counting system) so the other 2 groups of hex values could be anything from 00 to ff and anything inbetween an example b4 0f 99 gives us a purple colour, just another reason I feel we need to either add the alpha channel or move away from colours entirely.
-Cromwell

I'll keep you updated.
